name: wahongshu
description: 挖红薯：带内置浏览器的小红书媒体下载与备份工具
author: XUZIQIU

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
scripts.build:core: python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onefile --name wahongshu-core --distpath build/core --workpath build/pyinstaller --specpath build/pyinstaller core/downloader.py
scripts.dist: npm test && npm run build:core && electron-builder --dir --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build_unified.ps1
scripts.dist:staged: npm test && npm run build:core && electron-builder --dir --config.electronDist=electron-dist && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build_unified.ps1
